def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    k = int(data[1+n])
    a.sort()
    ma = 0
    cnt = 1
    for j in range(n - 1):
        for i in range(j + 1, n):
            if a[i] - a[j] <= k:
                cnt += 1
            else:
                ma = max(ma, cnt)
                cnt = 1
        ma = max(ma, cnt)
        cnt = 1
    print(max(ma, cnt))
